tasks.name: Automate the management of existing resources.

concepts.name: EC2 Image Builder

concepts.name: AWS CloudFormation
concepts.description: Declarative infrastructure as code using templates, stacks, updates, and stack operations.

concepts.name: CloudFormation change sets
concepts.description: Preview proposed stack changes before executing an update.

concepts.name: CloudFormation drift detection
concepts.description: Detects differences between expected stack configuration and actual resource configuration.

concepts.name: CloudFormation nested stacks
concepts.description: Composes reusable stack components by referencing child stacks.

concepts.name: CloudFormation StackSets
concepts.description: Deploys CloudFormation stacks across multiple accounts and Regions from one definition.

concepts.name: AWS CDK
concepts.description: Defines cloud infrastructure in programming languages and synthesizes it into CloudFormation templates.

concepts.name: AWS Resource Access Manager
concepts.description: Shares supported AWS resources across accounts or within an organization without duplicating them.

concepts.name: Subnet address capacity
concepts.description: Available subnet IP addresses can constrain resource deployment and scaling.

concepts.name: Infrastructure as code version control
concepts.description: Stores infrastructure definitions in version control for review, history, and repeatable deployment.

concepts.name: Terraform
concepts.description: Third-party infrastructure-as-code tooling commonly used to provision AWS resources.

concepts.name: AWS Systems Manager
concepts.description: Operations service for managing nodes and automating administrative tasks.

concepts.name: Systems Manager Run Command
concepts.description: Runs commands remotely on managed nodes without interactive login.

concepts.name: Systems Manager Patch Manager
concepts.description: Automates patching and reports patch compliance for managed nodes.

concepts.name: Systems Manager State Manager
concepts.description: Keeps managed nodes in a defined configuration state by applying associations.

concepts.name: Systems Manager Maintenance Windows
concepts.description: Schedules operational tasks during defined maintenance periods.

concepts.name: Systems Manager Session Manager
concepts.description: Provides auditable shell access to managed nodes without opening inbound SSH or RDP ports.

concepts.name: Systems Manager Automation
concepts.description: Runs authored runbooks to automate operational and remediation workflows.

concepts.name: Amazon EventBridge
concepts.description: Matches events with rules and routes them to targets for event-driven automation.

concepts.name: AWS Lambda
concepts.description: Runs code in response to events without managing servers.

concepts.name: Amazon S3 Event Notifications
concepts.description: Publishes notifications when configured S3 object events occur.

concepts.name: AWS DevOps Agent
concepts.description: Correlates application resources, telemetry, code, deployments, and operational context to investigate and prevent issues.

concepts.name: Amazon Elastic Container Registry
concepts.description: Stores and distributes container images for deployment on AWS container services.

concepts.name: CloudFormation deletion and retention
concepts.description: CloudFormation deletion policies and related replacement/update policies control what happens to stateful resources or snapshots when stacks or resources are removed or replaced.

concepts.name: Deployment troubleshooting and subnet capacity
concepts.description: Deployment troubleshooting starts with the first failed resource and its error, then checks permissions, service limits, dependencies, and network/subnet capacity.

concepts.name: Git and IaC workflow
concepts.description: Git version control records infrastructure-code history and enables review, branching, collaboration, and rollback context.

concepts.name: Deployment strategies
concepts.description: A deployment strategy controls how new application or infrastructure versions replace old ones and how much old/new capacity runs at the same time.

concepts.name: AWS Step Functions
concepts.description: State-machine workflow service for orchestrating AWS services and application steps.

concepts.name: AWS Service Catalog
concepts.description: Governed portfolios and products for controlled self-service provisioning.

concepts.name: IAM PassRole
concepts.description: Permission allowing a principal to pass an approved IAM role to an AWS service.

concepts.name: Amazon ECS
concepts.description: Managed container orchestration service.

concepts.name: Amazon EKS
concepts.description: Managed Kubernetes service.
